title: TAMIL-LLAMA: A NEW TAMIL LANGUAGE MODEL BASED ON LLAMA 2
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the research. The study focused on developing and evaluating a Large Language Model for the Tamil language.
